source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The campaign update closes large calendar-date gaps, but its end_at values stop at 23:59:59.000 before the next campaign starts at midnight. The inspected filter compares Date.parse results with millisecond Date.now using strict end-before-now and start-after-now checks. Thus the intervening subsecond times have no matching adjacent campaign. Later accepted campaigns retain this precision pattern. A focused boundary test should cover the last whole second, an intervening millisecond and next midnight before a future date-policy change. This is a static test proposal, not a measured visible notification failure.
title: Check campaign boundaries at millisecond precision
